specs.title: automatic accessibility rules cover the full run browser
automatic accessibility rules cover loaded numeric charts and their controls
automatic accessibility rules cover the open search modal
automatic accessibility rules cover the open narrow-screen navigation
actual React route keeps old-run data out while real worker replies arrive in reverse selection order
superseded same-run range cannot overwrite a newer zoom when its genuine response arrives late
selected-range loading never presents full-run loss as the selected latest value
a failed selected range leaves its summary unavailable instead of substituting a full-run statistic
malformed worker identity fails closed and a genuine retry recovers
malformed worker columns fails closed and a genuine retry recovers
malformed worker stale fails closed and a genuine retry recovers
dragging an auxiliary chart sets the same numeric viewport on all metrics and double-click resets all
chart keyboard zoom and roving tabs remain usable without a pointer
search dialog traps focus in both directions and returns focus to the trigger on Escape
bookmark survives reload and stays isolated by run, then can be removed
unavailable browser storage reports failed saving without a false saved state
invalid URL range is disclosed and reset restores the full recorded domain
layout and reachable keyboard navigation at 320px
layout and reachable keyboard navigation at 390px
layout and reachable keyboard navigation at 768px
reloading prepares a new view while keeping the recorded synthetic source time and revision distinct
an already loaded synthetic workspace can prepare a new viewport while the browser is offline
twenty distinct viewports settle with current rendered bounds and bounded real worker requests

specs.title: NaN interval is an actual unpainted gap with finite painted neighbours, not zero or interpolation
painted values align with actual numeric x/y axis labels for every metric
drawn deep-zoom step labels stay distinct and learning-rate labels retain nonzero magnitudes
a finite singleton between missing measurements paints a real point and a later empty response clears it
logarithmic axes draw only finite positive numeric tick labels
an all-zero interval stays a real zero line on linear and becomes explicitly unplottable on log
run browser filters, searches, sorts, persists URL state, and recovers from empty results
million-point spike remains painted in overview, narrow zoom and reset
non-finite values produce visible disclosure and exact missing-value inspection
duplicate, unordered and missing-step observations remain discoverable
log scale discloses zero exclusions and linear restores the measured zero
rapid run switching never paints previous run measurements under the next run title
keyboard search opens a run and chart keyboard inspection reveals measured values
export identifies a sampled viewport and retains spike numeric value
mobile layout fits viewport and navigation remains reachable
unknown run fails clearly with a working recovery route
a worker failure never substitutes fabricated values and has a working retry path
an entirely invalid viewport shows unavailable values and never fabricates a zero curve
initial worker loading exposes a reserved loading view before any chart is drawn
